Moreover, the effect of the grain size cannot be ignored for
ferroelectric materials. It is proposed that for samples with a parti-
cle size of less than 2 μm, the polarization of the material would
reduce as the particle size decreases owing to the inhibition of
the formation of macroscopic domains in fine-grained BF–BT
ceramics.48 Therefore, the content of MnO2 less than 1.6 wt. % can
promote the ferroelectric polarization of the samples based on the
consideration of the grain size effect. The optimal ferroelectricity
in the x ¼ 0:8 sample results from the combined effects of the
electrical insulation and the grain size effect.
